ESCALATION FIX (research-agent.yml) — exact human patch: in EACH `with:` block of the three anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 steps (standard Opus, deep-tier Fable, deep-tier Opus fallback), add a line `allowed_bots: "github-actions"` alongside `claude_code_oauth_token:`. This allow-lists only the repo's own github-actions bot (the sole bot that dispatches escalations, scripts/escalate-research.js) without opening to `*` (the action warns `*` on a public repo could let external Apps invoke it with attacker-controlled prompts). The action's actor matcher strips a trailing '[bot]' and lowercases both sides (src/github/validation/actor.ts isAllowedBot), so the bare login `github-actions` matches the github-actions[bot] actor. One line per step; restores the scout/coverage-critic -> deep research fast lane dead for months. Already documented with this exact patch in OPEN issue #430.

VISUAL-QA FIX (visual-qa-agent.yml) — exact human patch: raise `--max-turns 40` -> `--max-turns 60` in the claude_args of the single anthropics/claude-code-action@v1 step (matching editorial/coverage-critic's 60). Evidence this run: success 37480726102 used num_turns=27; the last 4 runs all hit the 40 cap (error_max_turns). Failures reach the cap in ~4 min, so 60 turns stays well under the job's 15-min timeout. Could alternatively be tightened from the NON-protected scripts/agents/visual-qa.md prompt side (improve agent's domain), but the direct fix is the max-turns bump.
